annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Communication from the Commission on the Quality Jobs Roadmap (COM(2025) 944 final)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Quality Jobs Roadmap (COM(2025) 944 final)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission's Quality Jobs Roadmap, urging shared job-quality indicators, social dialogue, workplace health and safety, and enforcement. A short section addresses AI and algorithmic management at work, calling for full implementation of GDPR, the AI Act and consultation rules, and possible EU instruments on algorithmic management.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for common job-quality indicators drawing on OECD, ILO and Eurofound work.
Social dialogue and collective bargaining should be central, including on AI in the workplace.
AI and algorithmic systems need safeguards against disproportionate surveillance, work intensification and deskilling.
Existing frameworks (GDPR, AI Act, information and consultation rules) must be fully implemented and strengthened where necessary.
Commission should assess whether EU instruments are needed on algorithmic management, psycho-social risks and the right to disconnect.
